newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga may hive off power generation unit.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga may hive off power generation unit.

text.p: Malaysian utility firm Tenaga Nasional Bhd plans to spin off its power-generating unit to a wholly-owned subsidiary which may eventually be listed on the Kuala Lumpur bourse, Business Times daily said on Thursday.

It quoted Tenaga's executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali as saying the move would remove any ambiguity or conflict of interest due to the firm's current twin roles as a power generator and electricity grid system operator.

"By operating power plants as part of Tenaga, but through a wholly-owned subsidiairy, Tenaga can buy power from it like it does from the independent power producers," Tajuddin was quoted as telling reporters.
